# Transform Data

```{r}
risk_data <- risk_data %>% 
  # filter(rt <= 5000) %>% 
  mutate(rt = rt / 1000)


# Assuming risk_data is your dataframe
risk_data <- risk_data %>%
  mutate(
    response = ifelse(experimental_treatment_selected == "Yes to treatment", 1, 0),
    RT = if_else(response == 0, -rt, rt), # Multiply by -1 if response is 0
    risk = risk * 0.01,                   # Scale risk by 0.01
    gain = gain * 0.01,                    # Scale gain by 0.01
    no_effect = no_effect * 0.01
  )

# This will assign a unique index to each different 'subj_idx'
risk_data$idxP <- as.numeric(as.factor(risk_data$user_id))
```

# Stop Time DDM

## Define the stDDM

```{r}
run_stDDM = function(risk_data){
  chen_folder = paste(base_dir, '/analysis/timeDDM/Chen-2021', sep='')
  scripts_folder = paste(chen_folder, '/Scripts/Model fitting', sep='')  
  results_folder = paste(chen_folder, '/Scripts/ModelResults/Neuroethics', sep='')
  
  idxP = risk_data$idxP
  
  hd = (risk_data$gain) # gain probability
  td = (risk_data$risk) # risk probability
  
  rtpos = risk_data$rt
  
  y= risk_data$RT
  
  N = length(y)
  ns = length(unique(idxP))
  
  #--------------------------------------------
  # fit the model
  
  dat <- dump.format(list(N=N, y=y, idxP=idxP, hd=hd, td=td, rt=rtpos, ns=ns))
  
  inits3 <- dump.format(list( alpha.mu=2, alpha.pr=0.05,  time.mu=0.5, time.pr= 0.05, theta.mu=0.1,
                              theta.pr=0.05,  b1.mu=0.3, b1.pr=0.05, b2.mu=0.01, b2.pr=0.05, bias.mu=0.4,
                              bias.kappa=1, y_pred=y,  .RNG.name="base::Super-Duper", .RNG.seed=99999))
  
  
  inits2 <- dump.format(list( alpha.mu=2.2, alpha.pr=0.05, time.mu=-0.1, time.pr= 0.05, theta.mu=0.01,
                              theta.pr=0.05, b1.mu=0.3, b1.pr=0.05, b2.mu=0.1, b2.pr=0.05, bias.mu=0.5,
                              bias.kappa=1, y_pred=y,  .RNG.name="base::Wichmann-Hill", .RNG.seed=1234))
  
  inits1 <- dump.format(list( alpha.mu=2.4, alpha.pr=0.05, time.mu=0, time.pr= 0.05, theta.mu=0.15,
                              theta.pr=0.05, b1.mu=0.1, b1.pr=0.05, b2.mu=0.05, b2.pr=0.05, bias.mu=0.3,
                              bias.kappa=1, y_pred=y, .RNG.name="base::Mersenne-Twister", .RNG.seed=6666 ))
  
  # monitor = c( "ld_comp",
    # "b1.mu", "b2.mu", "theta.mu", "alpha.mu","bias.mu","time.mu", "b1.p", "time.pr","time", "b2.p",  "theta.p", "bias","alpha.p") #,"deviance", "pd", "dic")
  
  monitor = c("b1.mu")
  
  results <- run.jags(model=file.path(scripts_folder,"tssmHT_model_priors_M1.txt"), 
                      monitor=monitor, data=dat, n.chains=3, inits=c(inits1,inits2, inits3), 
                      plots = TRUE, adapt=10, method="parallel", module="wiener", burnin=10, sample=100, thin=1)
  
  return(results)

}
```

                      monitor=monitor, data=dat, n.chains=3, inits=c(inits1,inits2, inits3), method="parallel",

  return(results)
}

## Run the stDDM over subject subsamples

We will take subsamples of the original data and run the function to be able to compare it to a normal DDM.

```{r}
set.seed(123)
for (i in 1:1) {
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  # Step 1: Select 50 unique user_ids randomly
  selected_user_ids <- sample(unique(risk_data$user_id), 50)
  
  # Step 2: Filter rows that match the selected user_ids
  subset_data <- risk_data %>% filter(user_id %in% selected_user_ids)
  subset_data$idxP <- as.numeric(as.factor(subset_data$user_id))
  
  # Step 3: Run your function with this subset
  result <- run_stDDM(subset_data)
  suum = summary(result)
  
  # Optional: Do something with the result, e.g., store it for later analysis
  # This depends on what you want to do with the results
  end_time <- Sys.time() # End timing
  elapsed_time <- end_time - start_time # Calculate elapsed time
  
  print(elapsed_time)
}
```

# Run normal DDM

## Define normal DDM

```{r}
run_normal_DDM = function(risk_data){
  chen_folder = paste(base_dir, '/analysis/timeDDM/Chen-2021', sep='')
  scripts_folder = paste(chen_folder, '/Scripts/Model fitting', sep='')  
  results_folder = paste(chen_folder, '/Scripts/ModelResults/Neuroethics', sep='')
  
  idxP = risk_data$idxP
  
  hd = (risk_data$gain) # gain probability
  td = (risk_data$risk) # risk probability
  
  rtpos = risk_data$rt
  
  y= risk_data$RT
  
  N = length(y)
  ns = length(unique(idxP))
  
  #--------------------------------------------
  # fit the model
  
  dat <- dump.format(list(N=N, y=y, idxP=idxP, hd=hd, td=td, rt=rtpos, ns=ns))
  
  inits3 <- dump.format(list( alpha.mu=2, alpha.pr=0.05,  time.mu=0.5, time.pr= 0.05, theta.mu=0.1,
                              theta.pr=0.05,  b1.mu=0.3, b1.pr=0.05, b2.mu=0.01, b2.pr=0.05, bias.mu=0.4,
                              bias.kappa=1, y_pred=y,  .RNG.name="base::Super-Duper", .RNG.seed=99999))
  
  
  inits2 <- dump.format(list( alpha.mu=2.2, alpha.pr=0.05, time.mu=-0.1, time.pr= 0.05, theta.mu=0.01,
                              theta.pr=0.05, b1.mu=0.3, b1.pr=0.05, b2.mu=0.1, b2.pr=0.05, bias.mu=0.5,
                              bias.kappa=1, y_pred=y,  .RNG.name="base::Wichmann-Hill", .RNG.seed=1234))
  
  inits1 <- dump.format(list( alpha.mu=2.4, alpha.pr=0.05, time.mu=0, time.pr= 0.05, theta.mu=0.15,
                              theta.pr=0.05, b1.mu=0.1, b1.pr=0.05, b2.mu=0.05, b2.pr=0.05, bias.mu=0.3,
                              bias.kappa=1, y_pred=y, .RNG.name="base::Mersenne-Twister", .RNG.seed=6666 ))
  
  monitor = c(
    "b1.mu", "b2.mu", "theta.mu", "alpha.mu","bias.mu", "b1.p", "time", "b2.p",  "theta.p", "bias","alpha.p") #,"deviance", "pd", "dic")
  
  
  results <- run.jags(model=file.path(scripts_folder,"tssmHT_modelWIENER_standardDDM.txt"), 
                      monitor=monitor, data=dat, n.chains=3, inits=c(inits1,inits2, inits3), 
                      plots = TRUE, method="parallel", module="wiener", burnin=1000, sample=5000, thin=1)
  
  return(results)

}
```

Loo Comparison

## Run both models for one subject and compare their loo

```{r}
library(loo)
library(coda)

extract_loo = function(df){
  num_iterations <- 5000
  num_chains <- 3
  cols_with_ld_comp <- grep("ld_comp", colnames(df$mcmc[[1]]))
num_data_points <- length(cols_with_ld_comp)
  extracted_array <- array(NA, dim = c(num_iterations, num_chains, num_data_points))
  # browser()
  # Loop over each chain
  for (chain in 1:num_chains) {
    # Find column indices that contain 'ld_comp'
    cols_with_ld_comp <- grep("ld_comp", colnames(df$mcmc[[chain]]))
  
    # Check if the number of 'ld_comp' columns matches the expected number
    if (length(cols_with_ld_comp) == num_data_points) {
      extracted_array[, chain, ] <- df$mcmc[[chain]][, cols_with_ld_comp]
    } else {
      stop("Unexpected number of 'ld_comp' columns found")
    }
  }
  # browser()
  es = effectiveSize(df$mcmc[,cols_with_ld_comp])
  computed_loo = loo(extracted_array, cores=getOption("mc.cores", 4), r_eff=es)
  return(computed_loo$estimates["looic", "Estimate"])

# Now, extracted_array is filled with the data in the format you wanted
  
  
  # rows_of_interest <- grep("ld_comp", rownames(df))
  # col_index = which(colnames(stddm_summary) == "Mean")
  # extracted_values <- df[rows_of_interest, col_index]
  # extracted_matrix <- as.matrix(extracted_values)
  # computed_loo = loo(extracted_matrix, cores=getOption("mc.cores", 4))
  # browser()
  # return(computed_loo$estimates["looic", "Estimate"])
}

extract_waic = function(df){
  rows_of_interest <- grep("ld_comp", rownames(df))
  col_index = which(colnames(df) == "Mean")
  extracted_values <- df[rows_of_interest, col_index]
  extracted_matrix <- as.matrix(extracted_values)
  browser()
  computed_waic = waic(extracted_matrix, cores=getOption("mc.cores", 4))
  return(computed_waic$estimates["waic", "Estimate"])
}

compute_loo = function(normal_summary, stddm_summary){
  normal_loo = extract_loo(normal_summary)
  stddm_loo = extract_loo(stddm_summary)
  if (normal_loo > stddm_loo) {
    return(1) # Return 1 if stddm is better
  }
  return(0)
}

compute_dic = function(normal_result, stddm_result){
  normal_dic = extract.runjags(normal_result, "dic")
  stddm_dic = extract.runjags(stddm_result, "dic")
  if (normal_dic > stddm_dic) {
    return(1) # Return 1 if stddm is better
  }
  return(0)
}

compute_waic = function(normal_summary, stddm_summary){
  normal_waic = extract_waic(normal_summary)
  stddm_waic = extract_waic(stddm_summary)
  if (normal_waic > stddm_waic) {
    return(1) # Return 1 if stddm is better
  }
  return(0)
}



```
